messages:
marta: Quick thread to finish the changelog + relnotes for the docs deploy (v0.11.0). Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1224 — need 3 bullets, one-line migration, and any Known Issues.
kevin: I'll add the SDK snippet updates (py/js). Keep snippets short (1-3 lines). Example: `client.generate('Summarize', streaming=True)`.
rachel: Adding migration note about streaming default flip and a tiny prefix-cache example. I'll also call out rollout guidance for Dedicated customers.
kevin: Known Issue: embeddings may 429 under sustained high concurrency when Dedicated burst is enabled. Repro: `wrk -t8 -c160 -d30s https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings`. Mitigation: client-side retry/backoff or route to non-burst pool.
marta: Link-check: link-bot flagged expired gist in examples/prefix-cache.md and a broken anchor in guides/rollouts.md#canary. Please replace gist with repo-hosted snippet and update anchor to #canary-deploy.
link-bot: Detected 2 issues: examples/prefix-cache.md -> gist expired; guides/rollouts.md#canary -> should be #canary-deploy.
kevin: I'll replace the gist with an inline example and shorten the sample to 3 lines.
ci-bot: CI queued for PR#1224: link-check, snippet-lint, and build. Results should post in ~5m.
rachel: TL;DR candidate for announcement (one sentence): "v0.11.0 — improved streaming latency, smarter batching heuristics, and small SDK updates (see migration notes)."
marta: Please add a one-line canary note for Dedicated: "Canary rollout will be staged over 48h with automatic fallback to standard capacity if burst is exhausted."
ci-bot: CI results: link-check OK, snippet-lint OK, build OK.
kevin: Pushed the inline prefix-cache example and the anchor fix.
rachel: Reviewing now. If no objections I'll merge tomorrow 09:00 PT and send the announcement. Assigning reviewers: @kevin @rachel. :thumbsup:
